answer: Make new agents post a refundable bond before they can earn: entering the wharf of the agent economy locks a deposit sized to expected emission, and identity is proven by a slow raven protocol - one attestation per checkpoint, no batching. A sybil spinning N violet-clone wallets must lock N bonds and wait the full unlock curve, so the attacker's capital sits idle while honest agents compound; a duplicate attestation triggers slashing, paid to the peers who caught it. Attack cost: principal forfeited plus escrow time. Defense cost: one refundable deposit per agent.
